system.description: Before your Embrace you suffered from leprosy or a similar skin disease. Your Appearance may be no higher than two Traits, and rashes, pale patches, and sores mar your flesh, obvious to any who look upon you. Mortal authorities refuse you entry to any city. For three Traits total, your condition remains contagious to those you feed from.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
